original_test_intent: Verify every approved SSD can be inserted into and removed from its mapped backplane bay normally, is detected and disappears as expected, and causes no unexpected storage, RAID, filesystem or platform error.
original_method: A qualified operator follows the verified hot-swap or power-off procedure for each approved drive/bay/cycle while the agent captures identity-locked enumeration, RAID/filesystem/health and complete logs before and after each physical action.
manual_activity: User approves hot-swap/drive/cycle/data plan; qualified operator physically inserts/removes each identity-locked SSD; agent only captures complete system evidence.
required_inputs: SSD stable IDs and bay/backplane/controller mapping
Cycle count and supported hot-swap or power-off procedure
Backup, rebuild/data-integrity and final population policy
Qualified operator, ESD, OOB/console and recovery owner
safety_requirements: Verify drive/bay identity and hot-swap support before each action
Quiesce I/O and protect mounted/RAID data as approved
Stop on resistance, wrong drive/bay, enumeration mismatch, RAID/FS/kernel/thermal/SEL error or access loss
Preserve complete logs without clearing or tail-only capture
Do not let agent power the bay, auto-reinsert, rebuild, power-cycle or retry
agent_execution_scope: Collect stable identity, enumeration, mount/RAID/health baseline
Monitor complete per-cycle state around operator insert/remove
Verify approved final population and storage health
Do not handle hardware, power bays, rebuild/recover automatically or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Approve matrix, cycles, data impact and service method
Provide operator and own recovery/rebuild decisions
Review per-cycle evidence and issue PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Partially applicable for observation, but unsafe SSH and tail-only dmesg cannot prove stable identity, complete per-cycle storage response or data safety.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use secure read-only lsblk/udev/PCI/SAS/NVMe/SMART/RAID/mount and complete log capture before/after each operator action, bound to serial/WWN/NVMe ID and bay.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: SSD insertion, removal, normal behavior and 15/8 timing fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Run identity-locked manual hot-plug cycles with complete automated storage-state correlation and explicit data recovery boundaries.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact scope, data safety and auditable per-cycle OS/controller evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Automation assists but does not replace tactile insertion/removal judgment.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Device names can reorder and RAID may initiate rebuild asynchronously; stable IDs and controller state are authoritative.

project_override_considerations: If the backplane is not hot-swap capable, every insert/remove must be performed powered off; no generic SSD assumption applies.
expected_evidence: Complete baseline and per-insert/removal stable-ID enumeration

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master, DeepSeek and GPT V2 agree physical insertion/removal is manual and OS evidence assists; GPT V2 fills safety/evidence gaps.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Execution awaits normal hardware/operator/data controls; static review is complete.

review_improvement: Makes each physical insert/remove traceable to stable identity and complete storage state without automating the operator's mechanical judgment.
independent_technical_reasoning: Hot-plug correctness spans two layers: mechanical insertion/removal and asynchronous controller/OS/RAID state. Device names may change and disappearance alone can hide errors, so stable IDs, full controller/RAID/filesystem evidence and operator observations are all required per cycle.
